scope: Corollary 5.11 (Twisted ordinary finiteness) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If a coefficient line on Y1 becomes a finite-character constant line on E1, its geometric cohomology is finite-dimensional in every degree and vanishes outside a finite range. This applies to all powers of the periodicity line and all finite tame determinant twists. For a profinite parameter T, the corresponding cohomology is Ccts(T, −) of this finite- dimensional answer.
